description.value:
A wave of frigid air erupts from you in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 cold damage and gaining 1 slowed level until the start of your next turn on a failure, or taking half as much damage with no slow on a success.

A creature slain by this power freezes solid in carbonite.

Cast with a tech slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 5
